name: Fluora
tagline: The operating system for the modern multi-location dental enterprise.
positioning: Fluora unifies scheduling, insurance eligibility, and chairside operations across every location into one measurable, usage-priced platform.

hero.h1: Run every operatory like it shares one nervous system.
hero.sub: Fluora connects front-desk scheduling, real-time insurance eligibility, and chairside charting across all your locations — so a 40-practice group operates with the precision of a single chair.

features.title: Eligibility that never surprises you
features.description: Fluora pings payers the moment an appointment is booked, flagging coverage gaps and prior-auth needs before the patient reclines. No more end-of-day claim reversals.

features.title: One schedule, every chair
features.description: Balance provider load across locations in real time. Fluora reroutes cancellations to nearby operatories and fills gaps from the shared waitlist automatically.

features.title: Chairside charting without the clicks
features.description: Perio charts, treatment plans, and clinical notes sync to the ledger instantly. Assistants dictate; Fluora structures it into billable codes.

features.title: Operations intelligence for the C-suite
features.description: See production per chair-hour, no-show cost, and unbilled treatment across every practice in one board-ready dashboard.

features.title: Multi-location governance
features.description: Standardize fee schedules, consent forms, and clinical protocols across the group while letting each office tune what's theirs.

features.title: Recall that runs itself
features.description: Fluora predicts which hygiene patients will lapse and launches the outreach cadence that brings them back into the chair.

testimonials.quote: We rolled Fluora across 31 offices in a quarter. Unbilled treatment dropped 22% because eligibility gets caught before the patient sits down. It genuinely feels like one clinic now.
testimonials.name: Dr. Marisol Trevino

testimonials.quote: The chair-hour production view changed how our board thinks. We stopped guessing which locations were underperforming and started seeing it, live, every morning.
testimonials.name: Aaron Delgado

testimonials.quote: Our front desks used to spend afternoons on hold with payers. Fluora automated that entire loop. My teams get their evenings back and our claims clear cleaner.
testimonials.name: Priya Vasan

For established DSOs running dozens of practices as one enterprise.
For national groups with bespoke integration and compliance needs.

homepage.footerBlurb: Fluora is the operating system for the modern dental enterprise — one nervous system for every chair, every location, every claim.
